posts.text: The Binance fight has moved into DeFi. An address Etherscan tags as Binance Hot Wallet Exploiter 3 deposited about $60 million in stolen USDT into Aave and borrowed 19,762 ETH, worth about $44.7 million. Aave has frozen its lending markets on Avalanche, where about 1.81 million AVAX from the incident landed, to stop the AVAX being used as collateral. Another exploiter wallet has sold 4.7 million UNI into ETH. Is DeFi now the front line of this hack? # Binance # Crypto # DeFi # CyberSecurity
